worldcombat.skill.poisonsting.summary: Fling a cheap ranged needle: tiny damage, but a long reach, a fast windup and a short cooldown. The needle sticks in the wound and the venom seeps in a beat later, with a chance to poison. Barbed needles keep poison better but fly slower and hit lighter.

The needle trails %1$s venom drops; windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, cooldown %4$s, and it can be spammed.

worldcombat.skill.poisonsting.preference: On: poison chance x1.3 and duration x1.25, but needle power x0.85 and flight speed x0.85 - easier to keep poison on, harder to hurt and chase. Off (smooth needle): flies faster with power x1.1, but less and shorter poison.
Beyond this distance it will not fling needles and closes in first; a larger value starts the point fire sooner.
When on, unpoisoned targets rank higher so the venom spreads to more foes; when off, all targets are equal and a poisoned one just takes extra damage.
When on, the companion may leave its post to point-fire; when off, it only casts at what it can reach from where it stands.
